shortDescription: Create and delete a DigitalOcean database

options.name: engine
options.description: A slug representing the database engine used for the cluster. The possible values are C(pg) for PostgreSQL, C(mysql) for MySQL, C(redis) for Redis, and C(mongodb) for MongoDB.

options.name: id
options.description: A unique ID that can be used to identify and reference a database cluster.

options.name: name
options.description: A unique, human-readable name for the database cluster.

options.name: num_nodes
options.description: The number of nodes in the database cluster. Valid choices are 1, 2 or 3.

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token. There are several other environment variables which can be used to provide this value. i.e., - C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN).

options.name: private_network_uuid
options.description: A string specifying the UUID of the VPC to which the database cluster is assigned.

options.name: project_name
options.description: Project to assign the resource to (project name, not UUID). Defaults to the default project of the account (empty string). Currently only supported when creating databases.

options.name: region
options.description: The slug identifier for the region where the database cluster is located.

options.name: size
options.description: The slug identifier representing the size of the nodes in the database cluster. See U(https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/api/api-reference/#operation/create_database_cluster) for supported sizes.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates the desired state of the target.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags that have been applied to the database cluster.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds used for polling DigitalOcean's API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(no) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: version
options.description: A string representing the version of the database engine in use for the cluster. For C(pg), versions are 10, 11 and 12. For C(mysql), version is 8. For C(redis), version is 5. For C(mongodb), version is 4.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the database to be online before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds, when creating a database.
